assertions.old_assertion: Execution leaves the old activation unchanged.
assertions.translation_or_limit: Approved model translation: inert image metadata replaces implicit activation state. Every finite native call leaves Data meta unchanged; captured durable source/witness sets are empty.

assertions.old_assertion: Wrong Utf8 input rejects with a contract error.
assertions.translation_or_limit: Current native assertion is Failure::InvalidQuery, not the removed AnalysisContract wrapper. Target-independent exact schema/row checking is in inputs/receipt.rs:86; the test executes the current native boundary with a Wasm target.

assertions.old_assertion: Missing declared input rejects with a contract error.
assertions.translation_or_limit: PreparedDefinition::check_invocation and Inputs::check_supplied reject scope/count before execution, independent of target. The test requires InvalidQuery and no guest entry.

assertions.old_assertion: An extra undeclared input rejects with a contract error.
assertions.translation_or_limit: The same three-case loop checks missing and extra inputs, no guest entry, unchanged Data/input memory and released capacities.

assertions.old_assertion: A subsequent valid input produces one row.
assertions.translation_or_limit: Values must equal [7]; the native call must belong to the exact prepared call and retain exact supplied name/batches/revision/coverage.

assertions.old_assertion: A selected SQL model cannot read events outside declared inputs.
assertions.translation_or_limit: The current test directly checks native table-not-found Plan errors for events and caller_rows in output/checkpoint/evidence/reason bodies. It separately proves a legal declared events input can execute.

assertions.old_assertion: Source-bypassing SQL rejection creates no active state.
assertions.translation_or_limit: Approved model translation: image installation creates no activation or result. Selected SQL body rejection occurs in read-only native definition preparation at definition.rs:259-480, not at the old automatic Install execution point. No instance admission follows a rejected PreparedDefinition.
